description: Fetches emails from Microsoft Outlook and starts the workflow on specified polling intervals.

options.name: Microsoft Entra Service Principal (App-Only)
options.description: App-only access via a Microsoft Entra app registration. Choose which mailbox to act on under "Mailbox".

properties.name: mailbox
properties.description: The mailbox the Service Principal should act on. In the action node this is evaluated per input item (an expression can target a different mailbox per item); the trigger resolves it once.

modes.name: id
modes.placeholder: e.g. jane@contoso.com or a user object ID
modes.hint: The user principal name (UPN) or object ID of the mailbox to access. App-only Microsoft Graph has no personal mailbox to default to.

properties.displayName: Unless restricted by an Application Access Policy (Exchange Online New-ApplicationAccessPolicy), the Mail.Read application permission lets this app read any mailbox in the tenant
properties.name: servicePrincipalNotice
fields
properties.description: The fields to add to the output

options.name: custom
options.hint: Search query to filter messages. More info.

options.name: foldersToExclude
options.description: Choose from the list, or specify IDs using an expression

options.name: foldersToInclude
options.description: Choose from the list, or specify IDs using an expression

options.name: readStatus
options.hint: Filter messages by whether they have been read or not

options.name: sender
options.description: Sender name or email to filter by

options.name: attachmentsPrefix
options.description: Prefix for name of the output fields to put the binary files data in. An index starting from 0 will be added. So if name is "attachment_" the first attachment is saved to "attachment_0".

options.name: downloadAttachments
options.description: Whether the message's attachments will be downloaded and included in the output

subtitle: ={{"Microsoft Outlook Trigger"}}
